title: Unlike the Vale and Kingswood, none of the dozen-plus open-moor tiles between the Kingswood's East Track and Highward offer a 'get your bearings' action at all, and elsewhere bearings only ever report distance to already-discovered landmarks, never to a hold's own exits/tracks — this made Wardmoor considerably harder to navigate blind and consumed a large share of the turn budget hunting for the town.
